@common.sizeUnit.byte.sameAsSourceJustification: Vietnamese nouns don't inflect, so one `other` arm with the loanword `byte`, exactly as macOS vi Foundation `FileSizeFormatting.loctable` writes it (`bytes` → `byte`, `Zero bytes` → `0 byte`; verified on macOS 26, plutil, 2026-10-06) and as the shipped `settings.listing.sizeUnit.opt.bytes` (`Byte`).

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyteBinary.sameAsSourceJustification: Unit symbol: macOS vi Foundation `FileSizeFormatting.loctable` keeps KB/MB/GB/TB/PB as Latin symbols (verified on macOS 26, plutil, 2026-10-06), and Finder vi (`SP24`–`SP26`) agrees.

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyteSi.sameAsSourceJustification: SI unit symbol: lowercase k is the SI prefix, and macOS vi keeps every size unit as the Latin symbol (S vi Foundation `FileSizeFormatting.loctable` keeps KB/MB/GB/TB/PB as Latin symbols (verified on macOS 26, plutil, 2026-10-06), and Finder vi (`SP24`–`SP26`) agrees); kept distinct from KB as English does.
